text:
sam: Need a one-pager for field on deploy modes (hosted / dedicated / private). Short, skimmable, and a landing snippet for the webinar.

nina: Agree. Keep sections: 2-line head, decision matrix, 2 benchmark callouts, security bullets, CTA.

raj: Benchmarks I can offer: p50 gen latency ~110ms (Dedicated), p95 ~350ms (hosted burst); tuned cost ~ $0.04 /1k tokens. Footnote: workload dependent.

maya: Webinar hook: 'Pick the deploy mode that stops surprises'  30m w/ demo + pilot case. Landing needs headline + 3 takeaways.

sam: For inbound routing, route security keywords (FedRAMP, SOC2, HIPAA) straight to AE + solutions. Simple HubSpot rules: tag=security if keywords; route=AE if ARR_est>=75k.

ops-bot: routing rules staged (rs-2026-12-01). Smoke tests: 6/6 passed.

nina: Add an "engineer quick box": sample prompt, expected latency band, tuning knobs (batch, quant, KV cache). One-liner about rollback = automatic variant fallback.

raj: Single customer quote idea: 'Dedicated gave us predictable tail latency and billing'  -Pilot: NovaHealth.

maya: I'll assemble draft PDF + HTML snippet. Target: draft in channel tomorrow AM. Sam will check routing in staging.
sam: Sounds good. Will ping sales and solutions for quick approval after draft. :thumbsup:
